Before you begin

Read the full pack directions before every use. Patch test as directed before treating a larger area.

Follow the stated application time. Do not exceed it. Remove gently with the included spatula and rinse as directed.

For external use only. Do not use on broken or irritated skin, the face, genitals or mucous membranes. Bikini line means the external bikini-line area only.

If irritation or burning occurs, stop use, remove the product and rinse thoroughly.
